decisions.reason: The source explicitly applies to the Weave Print. Zebra colour and scale preferences were separately established in messages 26 and 27 and remain unchanged.
Matching the original colour reference is requested only for the basket-weave print and does not change the deferred terracotta block-colour pareo.
The weave-specific colour instruction does not modify the deferred mustard block-colour pareo or its established colours.
